name: neondreams
description: A readable true-black synthwave theme with distinct syntax colors and optional, color-preserving glow.

commands.title: Neon Dreams: Use Compatible Text Rendering

neondreams.glow.editorBoost.description: Extra editor-only glow intensity: 1 matches the other surfaces, 2 is the default, and 4 is maximum. Does not increase terminal or explorer glow. Reload each window after changing.

neondreams.glow.strength.description: Glow strength from 0 (off) to 100 (maximum). Updates the installed stylesheet when glow is enabled; reload each window to apply. Shared by windows of this VS Code installation.

neondreams.glow.editor.description: Enable glow on editor. Reload each window after changing.

neondreams.glow.terminal.description: Enable glow on terminal (requires terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration off). Reload each window after changing.

neondreams.glow.explorer.description: Enable glow on file explorer labels. Reload each window after changing.

neondreams.glow.debugConsole.description: Enable glow on Debug Console. Reload each window after changing.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/glow.js && node --check src/glow-style.js && node scripts/validate-theme.js
